title: A Hopf Lemma for Holomorphic Maps into Hyperquadrics
summary: More than twenty years ago, Baouendi and the first author proved that a holomorphic map between hyperquadrics of the same signature is either totally degenerate or has a nonvanishing normal derivative for its normal component. This established a CR analogue of the classical Hopf lemma in arbitrary codimension, in the absence of pseudoconvexity. They further conjectured that the same Hopf-type property holds for holomorphic maps between Levi-nondegenerate hypersurfaces of the same signature.
